recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future work group wants a current comparison between ActivityDefinition order catalogs and StructureDefinition logical models, handle that as a new CDS/conformance clarification rather than reviving retired DataElement wording.
issue_request: FHIR-11505 was a Published/Persuasive CDS clarification request from the DSTU2 ballot asking ActivityDefinition to explain how it differed from DataElement, especially for order catalogs/master files where DataElement also described individual data that might be collected.
initial_application: SVN 10927, represented in git by c03a8aca84, explicitly named #11505 and added ActivityDefinition boundary prose contrasting broader activity definitions with more granular DataElements.
additional_context: FHIR-11321 raised the same boundary question from the DataElement side. FHIR-13094 was later Published/Persuasive with Modification and collapsed DataElement into StructureDefinition/logical models; git commit d0802c9b75 removed the old DataElement reference from ActivityDefinition. In current source, ActivityDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, DataElement is commented out there and has no source/dataelement directory, and source/history.html records DataElement as removed.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Restoring DataElement wording would be stale, and adding a new StructureDefinition/logical-model comparison would exceed the applied issue and is not necessary for current implementer understanding.
